page_title: Pixtamer: free batch image optimiser for Mac

summary.name: Pixtamer
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source native Mac app for batch converting, compressing, resizing and renaming images into web-ready JPEG, PNG, WebP and AVIF files.
use_cases: Converting a folder of images to WebP or AVIF
Making multiple responsive sizes of an image
Batch renaming image files with templates
Repeating the same export job with saved presets
summary.what_it_does: Pixtamer takes a folder of photos or screenshots and exports them in JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF format, with chosen sizes and file names. It can produce several widths of each image in one export for responsive web use. Saved presets let you reuse settings for repeated jobs, and rename templates such as {name}-{width} control output file names. The app shows real before and after file sizes for each image. Originals are not changed and existing files are not overwritten without notice.
notable: Sandboxed with no network access; processing happens on the Mac with no uploads or analytics
Responsive widths: multiple sizes per image in one export
caveats: Mac only; requires macOS 14 or later
